lines:
sequenceDiagram
autonumber
participant EC as Core Event Committer
participant AS as Artifact Store
participant TX as Atomic Commit Adapter
participant LED as Semantic Ledger
participant DB as SQLite
participant SUB as Core Subscriber

opt Event batch references new artifacts
  EC->>AS: PrepareArtifact(stream, expected hash and size)
  AS->>AS: Hash, fsync, atomic rename
  AS-->>EC: PreparedArtifactToken
end
EC->>TX: CommitBatch(binding LocalSqlite, expected head, events, attempt, checkpoint, dedup, outbox, tokens)
TX->>DB: BEGIN IMMEDIATE
TX->>LED: Validate backend, head, IDs, contiguous sequence, prepared refs
LED-->>TX: Transaction rows and invariants valid
TX->>DB: INSERT events, attempts, checkpoint, dedup, outbox
TX->>DB: UPDATE stream head and aggregate version
TX->>DB: COMMIT durability barrier
alt Commit confirmed durable
  TX-->>EC: DurableCommitReceipt(head, event IDs, checkpoint hash, outbox IDs)
  EC-->>SUB: Publish only committed CoreEventEnvelopeV1
  loop Bounded outbox delivery
    EC->>TX: ListPendingOutbox(cursor)
    TX-->>EC: Ordered committed entries
    EC->>SUB: Deliver committed entry
    SUB-->>EC: Acknowledge delivery cursor
    EC->>TX: MarkOutboxDelivered(outbox ID, cursor)
  end
else Duplicate key and identical request hash
  TX->>DB: Read original dedup receipt
  TX-->>EC: Existing DurableCommitReceipt
else Commit result ambiguous or failed
  TX->>DB: Verify EventId and dedup request hash on fresh connection
  alt Exact durable identity found
    TX-->>EC: Verified existing DurableCommitReceipt
  else Not committed or storage unsafe
    TX-->>EC: No acknowledgement. Explicit failure or read-only quarantine
  end
end

data.title: Atomic Semantic Event, Checkpoint, Outbox Commit and Acknowledgement
